shared_grammar: Cohort arc: 14-November night corridor (67–71: Prospect St./Inman Sq. pursuit-and-flight under sodium light) → lens-eye breather (72: Mario's Bolex tour) → deposition and fever (73–74: Notkin interrogation, Inner Infant farce, Gately hospital epic) → snow and gala (75–77: first snow, fundraiser run-up, transcript, abrupt finale). Shared grammar: night-corridor opener band (street-name + time-stamp) for 67–71; found-form transcript/deposition set for 73/76; recurring Gately-hospital thread (dextral pain, Abiding, visitors, wraith) with a quiet chart-and-lamp motif; accumulating snow from 75 through the gala; the finale (77) closes the book rather than ending text — the mid-sentence cutoff is honored as a designed ending with a bridge to the endnotes. Neighboring chapters share the grammar (corridor band, deposition set, snow) without cloning compositions.

Narrative braid P147–P503 in marathon set with strand dividers and relief: Fackelmann saga in unbroken long-haul measure; Joelle 'Q' interview as bare two-voice exchange (answers vs. lone 'Q.' ticks); A.D.A. close in slow confessional cadence. Progress motif essential — 44k words needs orientation.
entries.structure_note: P0–P146 meeting transcript (placards → greetings → limo 180 → spot post-mortem → Phil storyboard → Warning Dance → Yee fit → cue-and-ready); P147–P503 mega-braid: Gately hospital/Fackelmann saga (P147–P195, P203–P216, P279–P330), Hal blizzard (P193–P202, P217–P278, P366–P454), Joelle Q-interview (P331–P365), AA round-robin (P455–P458), A.D.A./Pat amends (P459–P503). Five strands; dividers carry strand identity.
entries.subject: EXCEPTIONAL (44k words, the book's longest): the weather-delayed ad-meeting transcript (designing the 'Fully Functional Phil' anti-Entertainment children's spot) followed by the mega-braid — Gately's hospital/Fackelmann saga, Hal's blizzard day, Joelle's 'Q' interview on filming Infinite Jest, an AA round-robin, and the A.D.A.'s amends visit to Pat.

entries.opener_composition: FINALE: arrival-frieze opener — the gala guests streaming in along a horizontal band, title set as the fête program ('GAUDEAMUS IGITUR / IMMEDIATELY PRE-FUNDRAISER-EXHIBITION-FÊTE'). The tumbler gets its own towering sub-opener. The final paragraph is set on a dedicated closing field: full measure, held air, and then the book's last mark — 'The…' — standing alone, followed by the endnotes bridge, not by more prose.
entries.palette_role: Gala palette: white-jacket tray silver, claret Volvo red, gala-gold — curdling into tumbler green (watery ocean-depths) and Sunshine overclear glycerine glare for the close. Celebration rotting into interrogation: the cohort's final color statement.
entries.reading_treatment: FINALE treatment: locker-room ritual in warm ceremonial cadence; Loach saga in fireside-story measure; tumbler sequence in green submersed set with the interrogation voice set apart; hospital bridge in fever gray; Sunshine flashback accelerating then SLOWING into the final paragraph — which gets its own screen/field, generous leading, and no ornament but the cutoff itself. A colophon-like closer follows: book's end acknowledged, endnotes (Part II) offered as continuation. The finale must CLOSE the book: arrival → ritual → interrogation → dissolution → silence → bridge.
entries.structure_note: P0–P8 gala/locker room (arrivals → audience-become-performers → ritual → O.P.L. → wheelchair rumor → Female side/Schacht → Loach saga P7–P8); P9–P15 Orin tumbler (glass → vent → faces → denial → Luria/roaches); P16–P18 Gately hospital bridge; P19–P30 Sunshine flashback (dawn window → C's entourage → Narcan-that-isn't → injection → hydrochloride taste → overclear air → 'The…'). The last word of Part I is 'The' — the design must not resolve it.
entries.subject: FINALE: the Gaudeamus gala's locker-room rituals (arrivals, O.P.L.'s return, the Loach saga) intercut with Orin's interrogation inside the inverted green tumbler ('Where Is The Master Buried') and Gately's Sunshine flashback — ending famously mid-sentence on 'The…'.
